instruction_summary: Artifact-level correction: re-cut the 001/002/003 living-update cards and findings to the spec's own gate rules (honest-partial validated set, same-set/same-q-regime 1998 baselines, gate-3b-conformant change metric), running only the three allowed gate completions.

steps.description: Read the provenance audit, spec, and all 001/002/003 result CSVs + replication table2a.csv
steps.command: Read immervoll-provenance.md, spec-living-update.md, welfare_by_year.csv, gate3b_change.csv, headline_scalars.json, frontier_by_era.csv, table2a.csv

steps.description: Transcribe paper Table 5(b) (no-UB 1998 rates), double-read at 200 dpi (transcription-fidelity rule)
Install tooling (euromod 0.4.0, pythonnet, .NET 8.0.31) in the fresh container; no data fetched
steps.command: uv pip install euromod==0.4.0 pythonnet xlrd scipy; dotnet-install.sh --runtime dotnet --version 8.0.31

steps.description: Gate completion 2.1: re-run NL gate-3 OECD-comparison households with 001's household code
Gate completion 2.2: retry FR and EL MTR add-on (gate 3c) once each
steps.command: python gate3c.py FR ...; python gate3c.py EL ...

steps.description: Re-cut all estimands from the existing CSVs per spec gate rules (V, V_delta, E3, E5, Denmark decomp, same-set 1998 baselines)
Write old->corrected claim map and the two canvas figures
Write deliverables: report, findings, corrected card, 003 addendum, gate-completion artifact

key_results.validated_set_V: {DK, FR, NL} (3 of 14; NL added by gate-3 completion) -> honest partial
key_results.Psi_w_lt_Psi_d_over_V_2026_V4: 1 of 3 (FR only; DK & NL Psi undefined)
key_results.ES_IT_removed: contradicted by OECD change (ES +34.7 vs +9.8; IT +22.9 vs -7.4)
key_results.denmark_minus24.3pp: -18.0 pp is the single 2025->2026 beta step (no gate covers it)
key_results.descriptive_8_of_10_UNVALIDATED: survives as descriptive only; 1998 same-set mixed-q = 10 of 10

comparison_to_original.followup: 1 of 3 over V (FR; DK,NL undefined); 8 of 10 only as unvalidated panel
comparison_to_original.note: DK & NL Psi numerically undefined -> not a reversal

comparison_to_original.followup: 3 of 3 over V (Table 5b no-UB); 10 of 10 descriptive stable-10 (mixed-q)

comparison_to_original.note: V_delta must be subset of V; -14.7 pp {DK,FR}-only retained as sensitivity

comparison_to_original.followup: removed - contradicted by OECD change (ES +34.7 vs +9.8; IT +22.9 vs -7.4)
comparison_to_original.note: gate-3b failers leave E5 and the card PTR-change metric

comparison_to_original.followup: -18.0 pp of -24.3 is the single 2025->2026 beta step; no gate covers it

comparison_to_original.original: DE, EL, PT and BE (4 of 10)
comparison_to_original.followup: BE, DE, LU, PT (4 of 10); 1998 same-set 3 of 10 (FR,IE,PT)
comparison_to_original.note: EL=1.22 not <1; LU=-0.00 is <1 and was omitted
1998 tau/a arrays never fed through the new aggregation path

comparison_to_original.followup: 12/14 PASS; FR, EL tau-unvalidated (aborted on retry)
comparison_to_original.note: MTR add-on aborts for FR, EL

deviations: V expanded to {DK,FR,NL} (3), not the provisionally-expected {DK,FR} (2): the NL gate-3 completion PASSED, so the conformant E5 median is -5.2 pp (not the instruction's provisional -14.7 pp, which assumed NL would fail). Both reported.
FR and EL gate-3c MTR add-on could not be completed (aborts on retry, as in the originals); they remain tau-unvalidated (instruction's stated fallback).

Tooling (euromod 0.4.0, pythonnet, .NET 8.0.31) installed in the fresh container to run the gate completions; no data fetched beyond staged files and the paper PDF (rule 5 data-provenance intent preserved).
